data.long_meaning: The name Devvanshay represents the divine descent of a deity or the lineage of gods. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' (god) and 'Vansh' (descendants or lineage). This name signifies a deep connection to the divine and a divine origin. The name Devvanshay carries the meaning “God's descent, divine lineage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devvanshay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's descent, divine lineage and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The Sanskrit term 'Devvanshay' can be traced back to the Hindu epics, the Ramayana and the Mahabharata. In the Ramayana, it is mentioned that Devvanshay are the descendants of the Devas (gods) or godly beings. This reference dates back to around 300 BCE.

Another historical reference for the term 'Devvanshay' can be found in the Mahabharata, specifically in the Bhagavad Gita. In this text, Lord Krishna states that the Devvanshay are those who have attained a divine state and are considered to be the gods themselves. This reference dates back to around 200 BCE.
